_comment: God-tier upgrade #3 — Stop-hook verification gate (DRAFT, UNINSTALLED). This is the 'hooks' block to add to ~/.claude/settings.json (the shared user-level settings both Frank and Duke read on this machine). CRITICAL: this ADDS one Stop hook — it must be APPENDED to the existing Stop array, NOT replace it. That array already holds Frank's discord-reply-guard.py; keep it. Do NOT hand-merge by pasting over the array — use the idempotent Python appender in STAGED-INSTALL-godtier.md, which backs up settings.json first and no-ops if already present.
